notes: English edition of powpop-depart. Requires the PowPop MCP server (https://global.powpow.online/api/mcp) and stops rather than simulating when it is unavailable. Posting is two-step: prepare_post, show the draft, publish_post only after an explicit yes. The 【Solo out. Together in.】 prefix is the recall index. Three search routes: invitation pool, origin side within 3 km, destination side by ILIKE; both ends are judged near by distance, not by matching place names. The skill never follows, messages, comments on, or friends anyone on the user's behalf.
